name: Hornero Quick Notes
description: Quick Notes 2.0: dashboard card with one persistent note saved through PluginKit Settings (same key as 1.x). Debounced autosave, Ctrl+S, flush on unload, clear confirmation, no processes or network.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Notes and Focus 2.0: explicit Persistent labelling distinct from session-only Quiet Notes, save-state and save-failure chips, pending-edit flush on disable/unload, Ctrl+S save-now, confirmed clear, word count, Ui primitives with Theme tokens, typed autosave/count settings (600 ms and shown, the 1.x defaults) and Argentine Spanish catalog. Stored note key unchanged, so existing notes carry over with no migration.
Dashboard card with one persistent note saved through PluginKit Settings, debounced, counted and truncated at 4096 characters.

note.description: Persistent quick note text (max 4096 characters). Same key as 1.x; existing notes are kept.

autoSaveDelayMs.description: Debounce before an edit is saved automatically (600 ms in 1.x). Ctrl+S and unload always save immediately.

showCounts.description: Show the character/word count line (shown in 1.x).
